source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 29. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: Yawning, sneezing, salam, good speech, please and thank you

learn.en: When you yawn, cover your mouth and try to stay quiet.
learn.title: Yawning

learn.en: When you sneeze, cover your mouth and nose and say Alhamdulillah. People who hear you say Yarhamuk-Allah.
learn.title: Sneezing

learn.en: Say As-salamu alaykum to people you know and people you don't. The nearest to Allah are those who say it first.
learn.title: Saying salam

learn.en: Speak good or keep silent. Always tell the truth, and speak clearly.
learn.title: Speak good

learn.en: Say please and Jazak-Allahu khayran — at home too! Whoever doesn't thank people doesn't thank Allah.
learn.title: Please and thank you

words.en: May Allah have mercy on you

quiz.en: What do you say when you sneeze?
Someone sneezes and says Alhamdulillah. You reply:
True or false? We only need to say please and thank you outside, not at home.

think.q: Do you say “please” and “thank you” as much at home as outside? How can you improve today?
think.a: Try saying Jazak-Allahu khayran to everyone at home today!

parents.summary: Small daily manners: yawning, sneezing (Alhamdulillah / Yarḥamuka-llāh), salām, truthful speech, please and thank you.

try.en: May Allah have mercy on you

parents.tip: Practise the sneezing reply as a family game.
